scope: Fresh eight-document authoring and one Review/Revision; independent spatial-design inspection, not resource or game acceptance
initialRequest: 我想做一个打砖块游戏。

findings.finding: UI §3.3 guarantees no HUD overlap, but final inputs at 390×844 yield intersections between all three pairs of score, lives and pause. At 600×800 lives also intersects pause.
findings.cause: Absolute anchor offsets do not allocate sibling space. The review checks three containment flags and misses the documented no-overlap requirement. Existing overlapCandidates reports only interactive/interactively overlapping siblings, excluding text/button and text/text pairs.
findings.limits: Rectangle intersections are confirmed; actual glyph painting was not measured. The documented no-overlap layout intent is nevertheless not satisfied.

findings.finding: The start layout has containment violations at 681×375, immediately above its 680px compact threshold; title and start button intrude into root padding. At 375×667, title/instructions intrude into padding.
findings.cause: The compact decision considers width but not the available height. Fixed 340px child widths exceed 327px of padded space at width 375; column flex shrink does not shrink the cross-axis width. Author and review sampled four/five sizes without the threshold neighbour or a declared minimum-space calculation.
findings.limits: 375×667 is an independent smaller-portrait probe, not an explicitly documented test size. 681×375 directly exercises the document's layout-selection rule.

findings.finding: Scene still duplicates UI game-view anchors and calculated host rectangles; Technical repeats those anchors and camera offsets. UI Review changes RES-HERO to atlas brick composition, while the retained start draft still references RES-HERO.
findings.cause: Documents remain independently edited numeric descriptions rather than references to the same final layout inputs. The resource-description revision did not update its matching draft.

findings.finding: UI §6 claims all touch targets meet 48×48, but pause is specified as 72×32 with minimum 64×30 and no larger hit region is declared.
findings.cause: The review did not compare its general guarantee with each declared control.

verifiedImprovements: All four screen/overlay compositions have actual inputs and calculator calls.
Author corrected real outsideContentArea findings without Codex editing the test workspace or injecting the answers.
Pause and result final geometry has no containment failures in seven independent sizes.
UI game-view and camera can be calculated through the same existing entry point.

usage.note: Provider-reported totals include native subagent requests; cache reads are not newly generated text. One initial 401 has unknown usage, not assumed zero cost. No dollar or Credit charge is inferred.

nextAction: Do not expand prompts, insert audits or repeat paid correction turns. First address the proven diagnostic blind spot (foreground sibling overlap) and validate it offline. Responsive choices and document/input alignment still require a subsequent real test; this run does not establish their resolution.
